details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (revenue growth), K2 (EBITDA growth and margin), K3 (capital investments surge), K4 (free cash flow increase), K5 (5G spectrum acquisition), and K8 (dividend distribution). However, it omits the core material meaning of K6 (planned 2026 network expansion investment details), K7 (mobile data traffic growth in Lithuania), K9 (construction of new Tier III data center), and K10 (appointment of Head of Enterprise). These omissions involve HIGH importance items for K6, K7, K9 and a MEDIUM importance item for K10. While the summary captures most of the key financial and operational highlights, the missing strategic investment plans and personnel change prevent it from achieving full coverage.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of strong financial performance. Revenue growth drivers are clearly identified and quantified. Profitability metrics consistently show improvement without contradiction. Operational details like increased expenses and capital investments are contextualized as part of strategic investments. The financial position description is clear and complete. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition. All figures and their relationships are presented in a manner that forms a coherent whole without internal inconsistencies.
